profile.address: 2800 Summit Avenue campus, Plano, TX (DFW-02 building)
profile.reading: Aligned DFW-02 sits on the same 19-acre Dallas-Fort Worth flagship campus as the earlier DFW-01 building in Plano, Texas, adjacent to Aligned North American headquarters. Per the operator own September 2022 press release announcing the expansion, DFW-02 was designed for 36 megawatts of critical capacity across 220,000 total square feet, of which roughly 185,000 square feet is dedicated data hall space. The release placed this project within a companywide plan describing more than 400 megawatts of new development beginning in 2022, and referred generically to hyperscale and enterprise customers as the intended tenant base without naming any specific company. The facility was built to a Tier III design standard consistent with Aligned other Dallas-area buildings. Aligned, formerly known as Aligned Energy, describes its overall footprint today as more than fifty campuses and roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas, with Latin American operations run under the ODATA brand. Ownership has shifted substantially over the company history: Macquarie Infrastructure Partners first invested in April 2018 alongside BlueMountain Capital Management, Mubadala Investment Company took a minority stake in August 2023 with Macquarie Asset Management confirmed as majority partner, CenterSquare Investment Management invested in April 2024, and Macquarie led a capital raise exceeding 12 billion dollars in January 2025. In October 2025 a consortium called AI Infrastructure Partnership, combining BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, agreed to acquire all of Aligned equity from Macquarie and its co-investors in a deal valued near 40 billion dollars, with a close indicated around July 2026 in Aligned own materials though not independently confirmed by a dedicated press release this session.
profile.research_note: 36 MW, 220,000 total sqft, 185,000 sqft data hall sourced to Aligned own Sept 2022 expansion PR. No named tenant, described only generically as hyperscale/enterprise customers.

reading.body:
Aligned DFW-02 is one of two buildings on a shared 19-acre campus in Plano, Texas, the other being DFW-01. The facility is designed to Tier III standards, which qualifies it for workloads requiring continuous operation with redundant infrastructure. The operator publishes no IT capacity figure, total power draw, or square footage for this building, making its scale unknowable from the published record.

Without a published megawatt figure, DFW-02 cannot be ranked among Texas facilities by capacity. Aligned states over 5 GW of operational and planned capacity across its 50 campuses in the United States and Latin America, but does not break this down by campus or building. Texas contains 133 mapped data center facilities, of which only 18 have published megawatt figures totaling 468 MW, indicating that most operators in the state do not disclose their capacity.

The absence of published capacity for DFW-02 means this campus cannot be assessed against the binding constraint of grid availability or the scaling needs of AI compute. Whether this facility matters to AI depends on information Aligned has not disclosed.
